description: Configurable issue-reference linking inside changelog entries. A project configuration file may supply a custom issue URL format containing an id placeholder; when a changelog entry references an issue by number, that reference is rewritten as a markdown link whose target is the configured format with the placeholder filled by the issue number. Input describes a release run with a configuration that sets the issue URL format and the changelog header/compare formats, plus a commit that references an issue; output is the rendered changelog with the linked issue reference.

cases.expected_output:
# Release Notes
## 1.1.0 (DATE)


### Features

* another commit addresses issue [#1](http://www.foo.com/1) HASH
